full.description: This is a low-power photomicrograph of breast tissue. The section displays dense fibrous connective tissue stroma surrounding benign-appearing breast ducts and lobules, bordered by normal adipose tissue. This appearance is characteristic of a breast fibroadenoma, a common benign breast tumor.

These pathological changes are consistent with acute injury caused by the ingestion of sulfuric acid. The findings are characteristic of a corrosive poisoning resulting from a suicide attempt.

random.description: This is a low-power photomicrograph of breast tissue. The histology reveals dense fibrous connective tissue interspersed with adipose tissue and benign-appearing ducts, characteristic of a fibroadenoma or a fibroadenomatoid change. There is no evidence of malignant infiltration or severe atypia in the sections shown. The stroma is collagenous and hypocellular, replacing normal breast parenchyma.
